name: Replika
tagline: Replika is an AI companion app where users build a personalised relationship with an AI avatar that learns their personality, interests, and communication style over time. It's designed for emotional support, self-reflection, and companionship, and has found a loyal audience among people experiencing loneliness, social anxiety, or grief. Replika adapts its tone and topics to each user through continuous conversation.
